questions.question: A man's annual income has increased by Rs. 5 lakhs but the tax on income that he has to pay has reduced from 12% to 10%. He now pays Rs. 10,000 more income tax. What is his increased income (in Rs. lakhs)?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Equate the two taxes. 
0.10(x + 5,00,000) = 0.12x + 10,000 
 Step 2   Solve. 
0.02x = 40,000   ⇒  x = ₹20 lakh 
 Step 3   The increased income. 
20 + 5 = ₹25 lakh

questions.question: If decreasing 110 by x% gives the same result as increasing 50 by x%, then x% of 650 is what percentage
questions.solution:
Two expressions, one value — set them equal 
and x falls out. 
 Step 1   Write both sides. 
110(100 − x) = 50(100 + x) 
 Step 2   Solve. 
11,000 − 110x = 5,000 + 50x   ⇒  160x = 6,000   ⇒  
x = 37.5 
 Step 3   Now compare the two quantities asked 
for. 
37.5% of 650 = 243.75        27.5% of 780 = 214.5 
(243.75 − 214.5)/214.5 × 100 ≈ 14%

questions.question: In an election, 12% of the voters in the voter list did not cast their votes, whereas 84 voters cast their ballot papers blank. There were only two candidates: Ramagya and Shravan. The winner, Ramagya, was supported by 54% of all the voters in the list. He got 1456 more votes than his rival, Shravan. Find the total number of voters in the list.
questions.solution:
Step 1   Let the list be 1000x. 
cast = 880x        valid = 880x − 84        Ramagya 
= 540x 
 Step 2   Shravan is the rest. 
(880x − 84) − 540x = 340x − 84 
 Step 3   Ramagya leads by 1,456. 
200x + 84 = 1,456   ⇒  x = 6.86   ∴  list = 6,860

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 2545800 votes. If 365500 votes were declared invalid and 30% people did not cast their vote, what was the approximate number of people (in millions) in the electorate who did NOT cast their votes ?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Valid votes. 
16% of valid = 25,45,800   ⇒  valid = 1,59,11,250 
 Step 2   Add the invalid to get the votes cast. 
1,59,11,250 + 3,65,500 = 1,62,76,750,  which is 
70% of the roll 
 Step 3   The 30% who stayed away. 
roll ≈ 2,32,52,500   ⇒  30% ≈ 7 million

questions.question: A construction project was estimated to be completed in 180 days. Due to rain, only 60% of the days were productive. If the work done each productive day is constant, by what percent must daily output be increased to complete the project on time?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Productive days. 
60% of 180 = 108 days 
 Step 2   So the daily output must scale. 
180/108 = 5/3 
 Step 3   The rise. 
2/3 × 100 = 66⅔%

questions.question: A quality control officer tracks the defect rates in 4 different machines in a textile factory. The first machine produces fabrics with an average defect rate of 1.8%, the second with 2.4% and the third with 1.6%. The fourth machine operated for 5 fewer hours than the average run time of the first three, yet its total defective output was 0.92 units. If the total number of defective units from all four machines is 4.12, and each machine's total production was identical, find the defect percentage of the fourth machine.
questions.solution:
Step 1   Defects of the first three. 
4.12 − 0.92 = 3.2 units 
 Step 2   Each machine produces the same x. 
(1.8 + 2.4 + 1.6)% of x = 5.8% of x = 3.2   ⇒  x = 
1,600/29 
 Step 3   The fourth machine's rate. 
0.92 / x × 100 = 0.92 × 29/1,600 × 100 ≈ 1.67%

questions.question: The marked price of mustard oil is 10% more than its cost price. At what percentage less than the marked price should it be sold, to have no profit and no loss.
questions.solution:
Step 1   CP = 10, so MP = 11. 
no profit no loss  ⇒  SP = CP = 10 
 Step 2   The cut, measured on the MARKED price. 
1/11 × 100 = 9 1/11 %

questions.question: If the cost price of a book is 92% of its selling price, then what will be the profit percentage of the sale of the book (Correct to two decimal place)?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Set SP = 100. 
CP = 92   ⇒  profit = 8 
 Step 2   On the cost. 
8/92 × 100 = 200/23 = 8.69%
